The '''Jedi shuttlebus''', also known as the '''Jedi shuttle''' or '''Senate shuttlebus''' or '''Senate speeder bus''', was a model of [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]] used on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Jedishuttlebus.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Jedi shuttle]]
The shuttlebus was eighteen meters long and was similar in appearance to the [[Magnaline 3000 airbus]], used as a public transport vessel in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].

Following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was escorted back to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in a Jedi shuttlebus.

Kenobi then traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to report to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Several other shuttlebuses were docked at the Executive Building at that time, presumably used by [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and Republic officials.
